Why Use TrendWala Utility Tools?

Create beautiful, scannable QR codes for your business, marketing materials, WiFi sharing, and print flyers. Customize foreground and background colors, adjust error correction levels, and download vector SVG or high-resolution PNG images directly in your browser.

Multiple Content Types

Create QR codes for URLs, plain text, WiFi credentials, Email addresses, Phone numbers, and vCard contact cards.

Custom Color Themes

Brand your QR codes with custom foreground and background colors while maintaining high scannability.

Crisp Vector SVG & PNG

Download in scalable vector format (SVG) for professional printing or high-resolution PNG for digital media.

Error Correction Control

Choose from 4 error correction tiers (L, M, Q, H) to ensure your QR code remains readable even if partially damaged.
